scope: Shared retrospective tensor contract; source adapters must establish equivalent clinical evidence before assigning a channel. This schema does not establish cross-dataset cohort equivalence.

policy.time_semantics: Retrospective event-time trajectories; storetime is not an online availability gate
policy.unknown_death_time: Retain cohort and mortality label; all temporal bins structural when hospital death is recorded without a death timestamp. Do not invent a death time or release potentially post-death physiology.
policy.window: [onset, min(onset+24h, ICU discharge, recorded death)); partial hours retained with exact exposure seconds
policy.direct_values: Accepted canonical values only; exact duplicates at source/item/specimen/time/value collapse; no conversion, clipping or imputation here
policy.gcs: Choose the complete assessment with lowest total GCS in each hour, latest on ties; if none is complete choose the latest partial assessment. Never independently minimize components from different timestamps.

neq.name: Goradia 2021 five-extracted-drug subset
neq.semantics: Sum concurrent recorded rates, then hourly maximum. Not a complete vasopressor inventory. Dobutamine is not included. No 60-minute SOFA gate, weight fallback or zero inferred from absent treatment records.
neq.overlaps: Identical rates for the same drug collapse; conflicting simultaneous rates or an unusable active rate invalidate that hour. Unresolved infusion endpoints withhold NEQ for the stay. Identical overlapping records are not assumed to be separate additive pumps.
neq.coverage: Only documented infusion intervals establish NEQ coverage; no-record gaps remain unknown, not zero.

policy.category_policy: Fixed vocabulary indices, not fitted category codes and not ordinal quantities. Raw labels remain in cohort metadata. Unknown/unmapped labels are NaN. Other source adapters require explicit mappings; matching integer codes alone does not establish cross-source equivalence.

missingness.missing_value: NaN; zero is an observed value only with supporting evidence
missingness.unsupported_channel: Preserve the feature position as NaN and declare source unavailability; never fabricate observations or silently impute a channel unsupported by that source.

identifiers.row_alignment: Tensor rows, labels, static features, exposure, method codes and cohort metadata must use the same patient order.
identifiers.split_unit: Patient; overlapping patients across source databases require a shared grouping before evaluation.

imputation.fit: Fit scalers, medians and model weights on training patients only; select methods using validation patients only.
imputation.evaluation: Final test patients must not fit imputation or transport for an inductive evaluation. Any transductive use must be declared separately.
imputation.artifacts: Save model weights, preprocessing statistics, feature order, selected methods, patient partitions and fixed evaluation holdouts.
imputation.transfer: Weights are not part of the common schema. Source-only transfer must reuse the fitted source preprocessing and feature order; target adaptation requires a separately declared fitting protocol.

compatibility.temporal: Match feature concepts, canonical units, order, aggregation, onset definition and follow-up semantics before combining tensors.
compatibility.static: Matching category integers do not establish equivalence; use explicit dataset mappings. Retrospective context must retain its predictor role.
compatibility.clinical: Keep source-specific culture mappings, SOFA evidence availability and cohort deviations in the dataset configuration and audit.
